name: application-timeline-scrubber
title: Timeline Scrubber
description: Horizontal draggable playhead and range scrubbers with tick marks for media playback and log or analytics time-range selection.
useWhen: Horizontal draggable playhead and range scrubbers with tick marks for media playback and log or analytics time-range selection.
avoidWhen: Avoid timeline scrubber when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Timeline Scrubber uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
